governance.note: The 2026-07-10-nyiso-60-ldc-transport keeper recipe VERBATIM with exactly ONE change, and it is a MEASURED-DATA transmission-limit swap, not a tuned parameter (rules 12/13/14/17, zero new free parameters): nyiso_nyc_lcr_tsl=True.
